## Getting Help

Ghidra provides context-sensitive help on menu items, dialogs, buttons and tool windows. To access the help, press F1 or Help on any menu item or dialog.

[Visit our Wiki](https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra/wiki)

[Issue Tracker](https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra/issues)

## Join the Community

Ghidra is one of many open source software (OSS) projects developed within the [National Security Agency](https://code.nsa.gov/). Complete source code for Ghidra along with build instructions have been added to the repository. Please read the updated CONTRIBUTING guide to find out more about how you can join the community.
